audit.why: Even poke at level 1-2, then Zyra's plant-backed Q-E and later her AoE root/ult zone control the lane from level 3 through late game.
Zyra's spikes are level 3 (plants online), level 6 R Stranglethorns (110/100/90s, knockup-then-zone), and every item afterward as her AP plant damage scales; Zilean has no late spike here.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0/1].side say 'Zyra' while content win[0/1] say 'Skill', and phases[2-6].side say 'Skill' while content win[2-6] say 'Zyra' — all 7 rows disagree between layers.
audit.why: Content whys already correctly describe an even level 1-2 poke standoff before Zyra's plants and CC take over from level 3 onward, staying ahead through late items. The full-layer sides and whys were left as a flat template and never updated to match.
audit.corrected: Move phases[0/1].side to 'Skill' and phases[2/3/4/5/6].side to 'Zyra', rewriting each .why to match the content-layer reasoning (win[] is already correct, no content edits needed).

audit.whatIsWrong: Zyra is misgendered as 'his'/'him' in loading, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[2].t, report[9].t, and report[10].t (5 lintFindings); breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown digit.
audit.why: loading/dos/report text uses male pronouns for a female champion, and the cooldowns field names Grasping Roots but gives no rank cooldown and never names Stranglethorns (R).
audit.corrected: Fix all five pronouns to 'her'; rewrite breakdown.cooldowns to include E's 11s cooldown and R's 110/100/90s.
